_memoq.alt: The Goodtime State: Vice City artwork featuring various characters including Macca the Gator holding a drink, a sun wearing sunglasses, a flamingo peering over sunglasses, and Chunkee the Manatee smoking a cigar.

_memoq.content:
Introducing Grand Theft Auto VI: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection, a premium Grand Theft Auto VI collectible set featuring all the essentials for a good time, inspired by Leonida’s hit TV show, Macca the Gator.

This exclusive, limited-edition Collector’s Box arrives on November 19 and is available for pre-order while supplies last. The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection includes: 

  • 6” figure of Macca the Gator with stash compartment 

  • Matte black GTAVI Oakley® Frogskins™ sunglasses with Prizm Sapphire lenses  

  • New Era® 9FORTY A-Frame snapback hat with Vice City Leonida embellishments  

  • Macca the Gator magnetic mirror 

  • Vice City swizzle spoon 

  • Vice City razor blade keychain 

  • Leonida Keys crossbody bag 

  • Chunkee the Manatee shot glass 

  • Leonida Keys enamel pin set in a custom metal tin 

  • Premium stickers in a stash bag  

  • Double-sided souvenir poster showcasing the full Leonida landscape 

All brought to you by Macca and his wetland friends. Grand Theft Auto VI game sold separately.  

Pre-order The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection now at store.rockstargames.com, and look out for the arrival of more apparel and collectibles from the Grand Theft Auto VI Collection at the Rockstar Store soon. 

Stay tuned for details on how to pre-order The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection across Asia, Latin America, and Australia.
